headline: 7 token contracts catalogued across Ethereum, Arbitrum, Base, and Avalanche; core ICL and governance contracts not yet enumerated

findings.text: 7 token contract addresses surfaced from official documentation (docs.re.xyz): reUSD deployed on Ethereum, Avalanche, Arbitrum, Base, Katana, BNB Chain, Ink; reUSDe on Ethereum
Official deployments documentation found at https://docs.re.xyz with token contract addresses per chain; no 'Deployed contracts' page found listing core protocol contracts (ICL, oracle, governance)
Hacken audit page confirms 3 audits performed but does not expose audit PDF links or scope tables from this URL; Certora and Hacken mentioned as auditors in protocol docs
No GitHub repository pinned in per-protocol context; discovery of source repo and deployment artifacts not possible
Multi-chain deployment confirmed across 4 pinned chains (Ethereum, Arbitrum, Base, Avalanche); 3 additional chains (Katana, BNB, Ink) also identified in token address table but outside pinned scope
No factory contracts identified; protocol appears to mint individual token contracts per chain rather than using factory pattern
All discovered addresses classified as 'token' role; core administrative contracts (ICL, governance, oracle proxies, Fireblocks multisig) not yet surfaced
All 7 token addresses traced to official documentation at https://docs.re.xyz; no off-chain snippet-only sightings

rationale.verdict: Discovery submission. Catalogued 7 token contract addresses across 4 pinned chains from official documentation. Core ICL smart contracts, governance addresses, and admin multisig controls remain undiscovered due to lack of: (a) explicit contract address tables in public docs, (b) accessible GitHub deployment artifacts, (c) public audit PDF scope tables. Next slices should attempt direct Etherscan/Basescan/Arbiscan/Snowtrace searches for 'Re Protocol' name tags and fetch audit PDFs via alternative sources to enumerate admin surface.

evidence.shows: Token contract addresses for reUSD and reUSDe across Ethereum, Avalanche, Arbitrum, Base, Katana, BNB Chain, and Ink. Confirms Insurance Capital Layer (ICL) smart contracts exist but does not list their addresses.

Protocol architecture: ICL smart contracts handle staking/minting, Fireblocks vault under multisig holds idle funds, Chainlink oracles publish price feeds and proof-of-reserves. Certora and Hacken audits mentioned but not linked.
Hacken profile page lists 3 audits performed on Re Protocol; auditor contacts and methodology mentioned but audit report PDFs and scope tables not accessible from this page.
Frontend application loaded; confirms active deployment and user-facing interface. No contract addresses or admin information exposed.

protocol_metadata.about: Re Protocol channels on-chain stablecoin capital (USDC, USDe, sUSDe) into real-world reinsurance treaties via Insurance Capital Layer smart contracts. Participants deposit into ICLs to receive reUSD (senior, 250bps spread, instant redemptions) or reUSDe (junior, 850bps spread, quarterly windows), earning yield from blended SOFR and sUSDe basis rates. Fireblocks multisig holds idle on-chain funds; drawn capital moves to U.S. trust bank for admitted collateral backing. Daily Chainlink-published proof-of-reserves and actuarial oversight.
